tools.Name: Scientific Agent Skills
tools.Description: A collection of 163 validated scientific and research skills for AI agents, covering domains like bioinformatics, chemistry, and clinical research.
tools.Use_Case: Automating multi-step scientific workflows such as drug discovery, genomic analysis, and literature review.

tools.Name: OpenMontage
tools.Description: An open-source, agentic video production system that orchestrates research, scripting, asset generation, and editing.
tools.Use_Case: Creating end-to-end videos (animations or real-footage documentaries) from plain language prompts.

tools.Name: Graphify
tools.Description: A CLI tool that maps codebases and documentation into a queryable knowledge graph using AST parsing.
tools.Use_Case: Querying codebase structure, explaining complex relationships, and mapping documentation without using vector embeddings.
